summary: Implemented the rich_measure and VerticalCenter feature. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative, explicit stack) and imports Measurement; rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, the Align width constraint in __rich_console__, and the new VerticalCenter class (render, measure, repr) before the main guard; rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options while still passing justify to _collect_renderables; CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased with an Added section (two entries, no height line); tests added in tests/test_align.py (repr, VerticalCenter render/no-padding/measure, Align width constraint) and tests/test_tree.py (measurement expecting Measurement(11, 19)). Nothing was run or committed, per instructions, so all tests are unverified; the change was checked by reading only.
